status: Ten AI-generated cube logo candidates. None applied as official branding.

items.name: 负形 M 立方
items.desc: 立方体的两个可见侧面共同留出 M 形通道，让品牌首字母成为空间本身。
items.subject: a single compact isometric solid cube, recognizable top rhombus and two sides. Carve a bold capital M-shaped negative-space channel across its two visible side faces so the M is structural void, not printed text. Maintain a clear cubic outer silhouette. Three flat blue face tones, navy and cobalt. Simple cuts, no internal details.
items.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a standalone CUBE logo candidate for Metis, an intelligent multi-agent workspace.
Primary request: Generate ONE polished original logo symbol using the following distinct cube construction. a single compact isometric solid cube, recognizable top rhombus and two sides. Carve a bold capital M-shaped negative-space channel across its two visible side faces so the M is structural void, not printed text. Maintain a clear cubic outer silhouette. Three flat blue face tones, navy and cobalt. Simple cuts, no internal details.
Visual direction: flat vector-like graphic, mathematical isometric projection, strong sharp clean geometry with very slightly softened corners, maximum three solid colors, extremely simple enough to recognize at 24px. This must clearly depict a CUBE or CUBIC STRUCTURE, not a random abstract symbol. Flat face colors only; no lighting, no shading gradient, no gloss, no ambient occlusion, no photorealistic 3D render. Single centered symbol on a square canvas, occupying approximately 68% of the width with generous even margins. Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, not a checkerboard graphic. Do not draw an app tile or background rectangle. No text, no caption, no typography, no wordmark, no mockup, no presentation board, no scattered parts, no famous existing brand mark. Deliver one final logo image.

items.name: 三面折叠

The outer silhouette must clearly read as a cube. Flat mineral green and dark forest green, no gradient. Not an abstract triangle.
